name: talk-slides
description: Build, revise and audit talk decks as claude.ai Slides artifacts. One skill with the author's slide rules (noun titles, charts over tables, detail in Chinese speaker notes, no decorative visuals, live data re-fetched on publish day), a 14-slide template generated by audited layout builders, a static lint, and a runtime audit that renders each slide in the Slides runtime and reports shrunk text, overflow, margin breaks and overlaps.
